Name: whenpc
Description: Shows whenpc usage on keys; press to hide or show the widget

Actions.Name: Widget
Actions.Tooltip: Shows whether the widget is on screen. Press to hide or show it

Actions.Name: Usage
Actions.Tooltip: One of CPU, memory, GPU, disk, network or temperature with a 60s trend, or a summary or drive space. Press to hide or show the widget

Actions.Name: Lock
Actions.Tooltip: Shows whether lock position (click-through) is on. Press to toggle it

Actions.Name: Top processes
Actions.Tooltip: The three processes using the most CPU or memory. Press to open the widget's process panel on that tab

Actions.Name: Theme
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the current theme in its own colors. Press for the next theme of the same skin

Actions.Name: Uptime
Actions.Tooltip: Time since the PC started, and when it booted. Press to hide or show the widget
